prediction_timing: before current bids; learn afterward; truth after final reveals
primary_rows: prior variance > 1e-12; equal game weights within seed
ci: approximate 95% paired intervals clustered by deal seed across profiles
gate_rule: positive MSE/Brier gain lower bounds; mean log-loss gain >= 0; no profile with clearly worse MSE
deployment: Diagnostic only; separate strategy validation required.
weight_note: Historical fixed 0.4 step, equivalent to weight 0.4 after raw-evidence refactor.
